facts: The acceptance fold is shared between the retained synchronous compatibility reader and the captured-observation event array, so acceptance watermarks use the same validation and monotonic cache semantics in both paths.

When the optional sessionQuery service is present, preparation observes the requested live Session with the request AbortSignal and projectionMode none, requires source === live, folds the captured events, uses the observation cursor as throughSeq, and disposes the lease after wire conversion.

The wire contribution is built from one captured event array; appends after the captured cut cannot enter the prepared suffix, and accept() still appends the same delivery-accepted event without independent I/O.
When sessionQuery is unavailable, an explicit legacyContribution fallback preserves the sdk-minimal and no-query composition behavior with one in-memory snapshot.

The optional session-query peer and dev dependency are declared, while the consumer uses a minimal structural service view so the optional query implementation does not enter this package's source-plane cycle.
Focused tests cover fixed-cut wire output, lease disposal, request cancellation propagation, prepared-source omission, forked inherited-prefix behavior, and the existing no-query fallback behavior.
